title: HELIX XREF: Position — PeopleSoft → HELIX → Workday
description: Maps PeopleSoft POSITION_DATA (POSITION_NBR, EFF_STATUS, POSN_STATUS, BUDGETED_POSN, MAX_HEAD_COUNT, REPORTS_TO) to Workday staffing models through helix/position-status. Also records how PS position hierarchy becomes Workday Supervisory Organizations.

mappings.notes: Position ID seeded from POSITION_NBR to keep budgets and history traceable.
Only convert vacancies that are approved to hire; stale vacancies inflate headcount.
VALIDATE: POSN_STATUS values (A approved, F frozen, P proposed are common).

mappings.wd_object: Create Position business process (in progress) or exclude
mappings.notes: Usually excluded from conversion; recreate in Workday after go-live.

mappings.wd_object: Close Position business process / not converted
mappings.notes: Convert only if needed for history; otherwise archive.

mappings.wd_value: Job Management headcount or multiple positions
mappings.wd_object: Job Management (Headcount Restriction) or split into N positions
mappings.notes: Workday positions hold one worker. Split pooled PS positions or move the org to Job Management.

mappings.wd_value: Position with budget (Workday Budget or Planning)
mappings.notes: Position budgets live in Workday Budgets or Adaptive Planning; link via Position ID.
Build Supervisory Organizations from the REPORTS_TO tree (each manager position leads one sup org), not from DEPTID. DEPTID becomes Cost Center. This is a design decision, not a load.
Use for budget-controlled staff and state-funded positions. Most PS position-control institutions choose this for staff.
Use for student workers, adjuncts, temps, and high-turnover pools. Staffing model is set per Supervisory Organization.
